newsitem.title: CANADA: Agrium sets Viridian debt pricing.
newsitem.headline: Agrium sets Viridian debt pricing.

text.p: Agrium Inc said it set the purchase price for Viridian Inc notes and debentures as part of its takeover of the fertilizer company.

Agrium said it set the purchase price at US$1,080.95 per US$1,000 of the 9-3/4 percent notes due 2003, set a price of C$1,165.39 per C$1,000 of the 11 percent notes due 2004 and set a price of US$1,238.27 for the 10-1/2 percent debentures due 2014.

The company said an additional payment of $5 per $1,000 will be made to holders of Viridian securities who consented to amendments to the applicable indentures on or prior to December 6, 1996 by 1700 EST.

As of midnight EST on December 16 Agrium had received tenders of US$197,431,000 of the US$200 million principal amount outstanding for the 9-3/4 notes, C$117,728,000 of the C$135 million amount outstanding in the 11 percent notes and US$99,600,000 of the US$100 million outstanding of the 10-1/2 percent debentures.
